quote: NuFlare Technology, Inc. (President & Representative Director, Jun Takamatsu, HQ: Yokohama-shi, Kanagawa, Japan) is honored to receive TSMC Excellent Performance Award from Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co., Ltd. (hereafter, TSMC) at the TSMC 2024 Supply Chain Management Forum.
NuFlare Technology was awarded for its efforts supplying ADVANCED MASK TECHNOLOGY CENTER with high productivity Mask Inspection System.

NuFlare sells directly to Tier-1 semiconductor manufacturers — TSMC, Samsung, Intel, and other leading foundries and memory makers — via wholly-owned subsidiaries in the United States (Santa Clara), South Korea (Hwaseong), Taiwan (Hsinchu), and a Germany branch in Dresden, with field service engineers embedded at customer fabs.

These are used with NuFlare mask writers starting with the EBM-3000, all the way up to the EBM-8000 series, and are being expanded for future generation machines to perform data preparation, process correction and verification of mask data to improve the fidelity of the final mask pattern.
In addition, the two companies announced that NuFlare has purchased D 2 S’ TrueMask ® DS GPGPU-accelerated platform for internal use for research and development.
NuFlare Technology will install a SUSS MicroTec MaskTrackPro bake and develop system into their main manufacturing fab, in Yokohama, Japan, in early 2015.
